# sinopia

一张图是一棵小小的 Python 模型树,渲染成 SVG:摆好位置的 `Box` 暴露具名锚点,形状带语义角色,
连线自己算控制点。输出内联进页面,并跟随其明暗主题。

整套想法浓缩在一张图里,由旁边的代码画出、随页面构建时现场渲染:

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: asis
import sinopia as S
from figkit import show

a = S.Box(24, 30, 150, 54)
b = S.Box(316, 30, 150, 54)
fig = S.Figure(490, 120,
    S.Markers("primary"),
    S.Rect(a, "success"),
    S.Text(*a.at(.5, .42), "declare", role="success", weight=True, anchor="middle"),
    S.Text(*a.at(.5, .72), "Box · Node", role="mut", size=9.5, anchor="middle"),
    S.Rect(b, "primary"),
    S.Text(*b.at(.5, .42), "render()", role="primary", weight=True, anchor="middle"),
    S.Text(*b.at(.5, .72), "themed SVG", role="mut", size=9.5, anchor="middle"),
    S.Route(a.right, b.left, "primary", shape="sweep", label="layout() computes coords"),
)
show(fig)
```

## 摆布盒子,而非摆放坐标

::::: {.grid}
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-warning title="手写"}
每个盒子都带字面 `x, y, w, h`。挪动或缩放一个,就改变了它的邻居和连线所依赖的坐标,于是一处小
改动散成满文件的连锁修改。
:::
::::
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-tip title="sinopia"}
用 `Row` / `Col` / `Grid` 声明嵌套,`layout()` 算出每个坐标。加一个或改一个盒子,其余自动重排。
布局后每个元素暴露自己的锚点,连线因此引用几何,而非数字。
:::
::::
:::::

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: asis
import sinopia as S
from figkit import stage, show

declare = stage("declare", "Row / Col / Grid", "of Box + Node", role="primary")
compute = stage("layout()", "stretchable computes", "x / y / w / h", role="success")
connect = stage("anchors", "node.right / .center", "feed Route", role="warning")
flow = S.Row(declare, compute, connect, gap=44, align="center")


def links():
    return [S.Route(declare.right, compute.left, "mut", shape="line", ends="end"),
            S.Route(compute.right, connect.left, "mut", shape="line", ends="end")]


show(S.layout(flow, S.Markers("mut"), links, pad=18))
```

## 按锚点连线,而非按坐标

::::: {.grid}
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-warning title="手写"}
一条连线是手调的 bezier 控制点,或手算的折角坐标。它们相对盒子是固定的:挪动盒子,曲线便接不上。
:::
::::
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-tip title="sinopia"}
`route(a, b, shape=...)` 取两个锚点(`node.right`、`node.bottom`),按所选形状算出控制点或拐点。
路径由锚点导出,因此随盒子一起移动。
:::
::::
:::::

## 颜色跟随主题

::::: {.grid}
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-warning title="手写"}
写死的 hex 把图钉在一种配色上。换到相反的背景,描边和填充就失了对比。
:::
::::
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-tip title="sinopia"}
形状带一个角色(`primary`、`success`、`mut`),解析为 `var(--bs-*)`。内联的 SVG 读取页面的 CSS,
所以同一张图在明暗两种主题下都清晰。本页每张图都如此。需要自包含(SVG 看不到页面)时,用 hex
`PALETTE`。
:::
::::
:::::

## 模型树

一张图在成为字符串之前,先是一个值。`Figure` 持有一棵树:frozen 的 `Drawable` 形状(`Rect`、
`Card`、`Text`、`Route`)与 `Element` 容器(`Row`、`Col`、`Grid`、`Node`);`render()` 遍历这棵
树、产出 SVG。闭集选项(`kind`、`shape`、`align`)带类型,所以填错值是构造期错误,而非静默画错。

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: asis
import sinopia as S
from figkit import stage, band, show

fig = stage("Figure", "the svg root", role="primary")
shapes = S.Node(("Drawable models", {"weight": True, "size": 11.5}),
                ("Rect · Band · Card", {"role": "mut", "size": 9.5}),
                ("Text · RichText · RawPath", {"role": "mut", "size": 9.5}),
                ("Route · Markers", {"role": "mut", "size": 9.5}),
                role="primary", kind="card")
elements = S.Node(("Element models", {"weight": True, "size": 11.5}),
                  ("Row · Col · Grid", {"role": "mut", "size": 9.5}),
                  ("Node · Label · Spacer · Cell", {"role": "mut", "size": 9.5}),
                  ("layout() computes geometry", {"role": "mut", "size": 9.5}),
                  role="success", kind="card")
out = band("render() → themed SVG · var(--bs-*)", role="secondary")
root = S.Col(fig, S.Spacer(h=28), S.Row(shapes, elements, gap=40, align="start"),
             S.Spacer(h=24), out, gap=0, align="center")


def links():
    return [S.Route(fig.bottom, shapes.top, "mut", shape="sweep", ends="end"),
            S.Route(fig.bottom, elements.top, "mut", shape="sweep", ends="end"),
            S.Route(shapes.bottom, out.top, "mut", shape="sweep", ends="end"),
            S.Route(elements.bottom, out.top, "mut", shape="sweep", ends="end")]


show(S.layout(root, S.Markers("mut"), links, pad=18))
```
